name: smart-budget-timing
title: Q3 budget review
lines: Thanks for joining, Alice. Today I want to go through the Q3 budget line by line, starting with travel and the offsite.
Sure. Travel is up twelve percent, mostly flights for the offsite, and the venue deposit landed in this quarter instead of the next one.
So the budget is fine overall, it is the timing. Can you send the revised budget to finance by Friday?
Yes, I will send it by Friday. I will also flag the deposit so nobody panics when they read the totals.
Then the only open item is catering for the offsite, which nobody owns yet.
Right, and the venue wants the final headcount for both days before they confirm the menu.

name: smart-hiring
title: Support hiring
lines: We have two strong candidates for the support role, but only budget for one until January.
One has five years in support but no German, the other speaks German but is new to the job.
Half of our tickets this quarter came from customers in Germany and Austria.
Okay. When do we have to tell them?
The recruiter wants an answer by Monday, otherwise the first candidate takes another offer.

name: smart-agenda-early
title: Website relaunch kick-off
typed: Agenda: launch date, who writes the copy, the budget for photos
lines: Hi Lena, thanks for making time. Shall we start with the launch date?
Sure. Marketing would like the first week of March, but the copy isn't started yet.
Who was going to write the copy?
We never decided. It was either us or the agency.

name: skill-decisions
title: Offsite planning
summary:
## Recap
The team planned the spring offsite.

## Action plan
### Ben Carter
- [ ] Book the hotel (due: next Friday)

## Decisions
- Hold the offsite in Lisbon
- Move it to the second week of May
lines: So where do we land on the city? Berlin was the other option.
Lisbon. Flights are cheaper for most of the team and the venue has space for everyone.
Agreed, Lisbon it is. And the dates?
April clashes with the product launch, so let us move it to the second week of May.
Fine by me. Ben, can you book the hotel by next Friday?
Yes, I will book it by next Friday.

name: skill-risks-supplier
title: Supplier review
lines: The new packaging supplier is ten percent cheaper, which is why we liked them.
But their warehouse had a fire last year and they never told us whether their insurance covers our stock.
That worries me. What happens to our orders if it happens again?
Nobody has checked. We also only have one supplier for the lids, so if they are late the whole line stops.
Okay, let us not sign anything until we know about the insurance.

name: skill-decisions-with-words
title: Offsite planning
lines: Lisbon then, we agreed on the city last week.
And for the dates, April clashes with the launch, so the second week of May.
Second week of May, agreed. I will tell the team.

name: skill-coach-me
title: Design review
lines: So yeah I think the new design is kind of fine, maybe, we could maybe change some things at some point.
Which things? I need to know what to change before Thursday.
Just, you know, the colours and stuff. Let us see how it goes.
Okay, and who signs it off?
Not sure. Someone from marketing probably.
